name: vr-ar-development
description: VR and AR Development: the perceptual constraints (motion-to-photon latency, cybersickness, the vergence-accommodation conflict, presence), displays and optics, tracking, the XR rendering pipeline including reprojection and foveated rendering, input and interaction with locomotion as the highest-risk design decision, AR spatial understanding, platforms and APIs, spatial audio, comfort, safety and accessibility, UX design for 3D, and performance budgeting.
